alpha_agent.pre_registration_protocol: Charter §5 ex-ante hypothesis declaration. Sign(F1) = -1 (herding-reversal direction) is COMMITTED BEFORE measurement. No post-hoc sign-flip permitted. If F1 univariate t-stat shows opposite sign at measurement time, fail honestly and declare V2_FIAPAS REJECTED — no V3 sign-flip retry.

F1_FIAP_composite.sign_rationale: herding-reversal mechanism: foreign+institutional consensus + persistence + concentration marks buying-cycle peak in KR retail-dominated equities → mean-reversal in next 1M. Citations: Kim-Kim (2014 PBFJ) + Hwang-Salmon (2004 JEF) for KR foreign herding mean-reversion at monthly horizon. Sign declared BEFORE Iter 10 measurement.
F1_FIAP_composite.formula: Cross-sectional Z[ -0.20*Z(INV07_Retail_Contrarian) + 0.30*Z(INV08_Foreign_Inst_Agreement) + 0.30*Z(INV09_Flow_Persistence) + 0.20*Z(INV11_Foreign_Concentration) ] then global multiplier x (-1)
F1_FIAP_composite.data_source: investor flow factors INV07-INV11 from Factor DB monthly parquets, t-1 settlement

F2_AC22_Accrual_Volatility.sign_rationale: Dechow-Dichev (2002 AR) accrual quality — high accrual volatility = noisy earnings = mispricing → low-volatility stocks outperform. Sign declared as registry default (higher Z_Score_Aligned = better).
F2_AC22_Accrual_Volatility.data_source: Factor DB AC22, annual May DART filing 45d lag

F3_dropped_pre_measurement.reason: Codex Iter 9 C4 ACCEPT — V2_F1F2 ICIR 0.312 > V2_ALL ICIR 0.275 (F3 marginal-negative). F3 univariate t = +1.50 well below |t|>=3 threshold. Drop pre-measurement to maintain ICIR + reduce DSR penalty (n_candidates 6 → 3).

sign_flip_prohibition.rule: If F1 univariate t-stat at Iter 10 measurement shows opposite sign of pre-registered (-1), MUST declare hypothesis FAILED. No V3 with sign +1 retry permitted. This commits the Iter 10 redesign to ex-ante mechanism integrity.
sign_flip_prohibition.post_hoc_protection: any spec found post-measurement with opposite sign must be reported in alpha_validation as FAIL_PRE_REGISTRATION_VIOLATION.
